description: This file contains the implementation of the NarratorNotifier class, which manages accessibility notifications for a UI component, including announcing messages and registering dependency properties.

classes.name: NarratorNotifier
classes.description: A class responsible for managing narrator notifications and accessibility announcements within the application.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Announces a narrator message if valid, creating the announcement element if necessary, and raising the notification event.

methods.name: RegisterDependencyProperties
methods.description: Registers the dependency property used for narrator announcements.

methods.name: OnAnnouncementChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the announcement dependency property changes, triggering a new announcement.
